answers.core: In addition to improving support for external editors, this could also improve the usability of the built-in editor for people with mobility/dexterity disabilities that prevent them from easily clicking and dragging a mouse while simultaneously holding the Ctrl key.
answers.workaround: Can be "worked around" by manually writing every onready declaration ever used, or by temporarily disabling the external editor option and performing the action using the built-in editor. Neither option is very convenient.

title: Add onready var Ctrl+drag and drop alternative for external editors
